'''Robert Jordan's ''The Wheel of Time'' Calendar 2009''' was a calendar published in July 2008.

As explained in a letter in the calendar, all of [[Robert Jordan]]'s royalties as well as a portion of Tor's proceeds from the sale of this calendar were donated to the [[Wikipedia:Mayo Clinic|Mayo Clinic]] for [[Wikipedia:amyloidosis|amyloidosis]] research.
